author: Michael Larabel
description: Out today is GNU Automake 1.20 with the new --enable-jobserver option and opting for GPLv3+ licensing...
title: Automake 1.20 Brings New Features, Desires To Re-Establish GNU As Leading Build System

author: Michael Larabel
description: While FreeBSD has been working to improve its desktop and laptop experience, that work isn't yet shipping in released form for the OS installer and other ongoing efforts. Now there's a new desktop FreeBSD distribution on the scene with HyprBSD providing a Wayland-based desktop experience and with the Linux binary compatibility layer even an easy route to gaming with Steam...
title: HyprBSD Provides Wayland-Based Desktop Built Atop FreeBSD, Complete With Steam Gaming

author: Michael Larabel
description: Kmorph aims to provide reboot-less kernel crash recovery for Linux systems and can yield as little as ~2 second downtime for recovering the Nginx web server or other important services in the case of a kernel crash...
title: Kmorph Aims To Provide Rebootless Linux Kernel Crash Recovery

author: Michael Larabel
description: Vulkan 1.4.368 is out as the newest weekly spec update for this high performance graphics and compute API...
title: Vulkan 1.4.368 Released With New Extensions From Valve & NVIDIA

author: Michael Larabel
description: Microsoft released Azure Linux 3.0.2022 on Friday night as the newest version of their in-house Linux distribution. Given the rampant AI/LLM-fueled bug reporting and security research, Azure Linux 3.0.2022 ends up incorporating more than 470 security fixes for different CVEs across the many open-source projects making up Azure Linux...
title: Microsoft's Azure Linux 3.0.2022 Ships With More Than 470 Security Fixes

author: Michael Larabel
description: Given the recent Linux 7.3 upstream kernel release, the Asahi Linux project published a new status report to outline recent code they have upstreamed to the mainline kernel as well as other efforts taking shape in their downstream codebase...
title: Asahi Linux Makes Progress On Gaming, More Apple Silicon Upstreaming
